items.difficulty_reason: H2: beyond the already counted corrected exceptional-dimension construction, the author must turn vector lattice escape into a uniform spectral estimate across all frequencies in a fixed band and all weakly Lipschitz observables. This uses population-vector lattice comparisons, a product estimate with its exact cylinder-level threshold, and the logarithmic choice of approximation level that balances the nonconstant roof/cylinder errors with the desired power. The argument then transports the estimate through nonuniform first-return inducing and telescoping while preserving the normalized roof slice, eligible Oseledets subspace and weak-Lipschitz norm. All these new source-local estimates and transport steps are supplied together; the old nonroutine dimension core remains explicit input and is not counted again.
